description: Three-phase power meter with Modbus RTU: system and per-phase energy, power, power factor, current, voltage and demand as 16-bit registers with a selectable data scalar
source: DENT Instruments, Operator's Guide PowerScout 3 plus Modbus, Appendix D: PowerScout 3 Plus Modbus Register Assignment Tables

sources.title: Operator's Guide PowerScout 3 plus Modbus
sources.note: Appendix D register tables; Data Scaling section (table III-5, data scalars)

notes: DENT Instruments PowerScout 3 Plus (this map was listed as PowerScout 3/8 ViewPoint, after the ViewPoint software). The register table is the one of the PowerScout 3 Plus operator's guide; the older PowerScout 3 uses the same 44001 table, but its own manual was not checked.
The guide numbers registers from 40001 (offset 4000 = register 44001), so this map uses address_base 1 with the register numbers of the guide. Function 03 reads the registers.
All values are unsigned 16-bit. Values that need two registers are LSW first (word order little): value = MSW x 65536 + LSW.

Registers 44001 to 44061 are scaled by the data scalar in register 44602. Scalar 0: kW/kvar/kVA and their energies x 0.00001, amps x 0.01, volts x 0.1. Scalar 1: x 0.001, amps x 0.1, volts x 0.1. Scalar 2: x 0.01, amps x 0.1, volts x 0.1. Scalar 3: x 0.1, amps x 0.1, volts x 0.1. Scalar 4: x 1, amps x 1, volts x 1. Scalar 5: x 10, amps x 1, volts x 1. Scalar 6 or more: x 100, amps x 1, volts x 1. Power factor is always x 0.01.

registers.name: Time since reset
registers.description: Seconds since the kWh registers were reset. Registers 44062 (LSW) and 44063 (MSW).

registers.description: System kWh divided by the hours since reset (resettable). Raw value x the data scalar of register 44602 (see the scalar table in the notes).

registers.description: Minimum average power window. Raw value x the data scalar of register 44602 (see the scalar table in the notes).

registers.name: System maximum apparent demand
registers.description: Resettable. Shows the default value after a clear until one demand window has passed. Raw value x the data scalar of register 44602 (see the scalar table in the notes).

registers.name: System apparent demand now
registers.description: Average kVA of the current demand window (resettable). Raw value x the data scalar of register 44602 (see the scalar table in the notes).

registers.name: System maximum reactive demand

registers.name: Synchronize
registers.description: Synchronization register for several PowerScouts.

registers.name: Clear accumulated measurements
registers.description: Write 1234 to reset the accumulated data (kWh, kvarh, kVAh, demand) to the default values.

registers.name: Model
registers.description: 10 ASCII characters in registers 44201 to 44205.

registers.name: Serial number
registers.description: 10 ASCII characters in registers 44206 to 44210.

registers.name: CT type
registers.description: 1 = mV, 2 = Rogowski coil (RoCoil).

registers.name: Slave ID mode
registers.description: 1 = Veris, any other value = DENT.

registers.name: Data scalar
registers.description: 0 to 6; sets the scaling of registers 44001 to 44061 (see notes).

registers.name: Demand window size
registers.description: Default 15 minutes.

registers.name: Volts multiplier
registers.description: Multiplies all voltage values, for a step-down transformer.

registers.name: Amps multiplier
registers.description: Multiplies all current values, for x:5 A CTs or one CT on a balanced three-phase load.

registers.name: Communication setting
registers.description: Baud code (900 = 9600, 1900 = 19200, 3800 = 38400, 5700 = 57600, 7600 = 76800, 11500 = 115200) plus parity (00 none, 10 odd, 20 even) plus stop bits (1 or 2). Example: 901 = 9600 baud, no parity, 1 stop bit.

registers.name: Protocol switch
registers.description: Write 1883 to change to BACnet mode.
